hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: A Century of Authentic South Indian Flavors
hero.subtitle: Step into a timeless tradition at Central Tiffin Room, where every dish tells a story of heritage, culinary mastery, and the boundless love of our Bengaluru community.

about.title: The Enduring Story of Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room (CTR), also known as Central Tiffin Rooms, is a legendary hotel steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, Central Tiffin Room has been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages.
about.paragraph2: CTR’s rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers, Mr. Sanjeev Poojari to the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory. If there’s one thing that mirrors the Central Tiffin Room brand, it is the sheer love of our patrons who have been showering us with boundless love and support for the last 100+ years.
